dropped_candidates._drop_detail: Gate 3 FAIL (Alaska AI nexus absent): Decision date 2026-06-10 is within both the 30-day and 45-day windows. Treating a non-AI governance decision as an Alaska AI decision because the org holds AI contracts elsewhere collapses the column's mandate, identical to the GCI Starlink candidate dropped last cycle. Hard, non-waivable Gate 3 failure.
